description: Integer exponentiation with overflow bounds proof. Z3 can verify base cases (exp == 0 → 1, exp == 1 → base) and inductive overflow limits via checked_mul. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/math/pow — verified integer exponentiation'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm already uses (checked_add, checked_sub, checked_mul, safe_narrow, conditional expressions).

atoms.name: pow_small
atoms.description: Small-exponent integer power for exp in {0, 1, 2, 3}. Explicit branches keep Z3's non-linear reasoning tractable.

atoms.name: pow_saturating
atoms.description: Saturating integer power: returns max_val if the result would overflow. Safe for any non-negative base and exp.
